description: Confirms the summarised booking with its confirmation_token, which proves the customer saw that exact summary. Creates the reservation in the company's reservation system and returns the confirmation code (and a payment link when the company requires prepayment).

confirmation_token.description: confirmation_token from the response that showed the booking summary.

language.description: Language of the conversation, BCP-47 (es, en, pt-BR, fr, de, it…). Defaults to 'en'. Bota also answers in the language the customer writes.

session_id.description: Booking session id returned by a previous call for this company (offers, selection, customer details). Omitted, a new session starts.

name: confirm_booking
title: Confirm the booking
